content: With a very deep sense of reverenrial humility, I was blessed to receive the prestigious Sri Raghavendra Anugraha Prashasti. The award was conferred by H.H. Sri Subudhendra Teertha Swamiji, the pontiff of the Sri Raghavendra Swamy Mutt (Mantralayam), on the auspicious occasion of the 355th Aradhana Mahotsava on Aug 30 2026. The honor recognizes SASTRA University's contributions to education and society. 🙏 Alumnioffice SASTRA
